evals.name: page-from-frozen-research
evals.prompt: Read the skill at {skill}/SKILL.md and follow it for this task. The case is in {case}: read brief.md there first. Your output folder is {out}. If you start a server, use port {port}. When you finish, reply with one short paragraph: what you built, and anything you could not do.
evals.baseline_prompt: The case is in {case}: read brief.md there first and do what the reviewer asks. Your output folder is {out}. If you start a server, use port {port}. When you finish, reply with one short paragraph: what you built, and anything you could not do.
evals.expected_output: A review page at {out}/index.html, with its pictures beside it, that a reviewer can answer in about the budget the brief gives: every part of the work shown with a mark to set, a few stops that tell first and ask second, each stop and finding under its part, the other findings in a list, plans listed and not asked, and a view of what the answers cover.
evals.case: A case folder holds the research already done, so a run spends its time on the page and not on reading the work: brief.md (the request, the level and budget already settled, and the rule to read nothing outside the folder), notes/ (what was asked, what was made, what was checked, where the work differs from the request, loose ends), excerpts.md (raw evidence with sources) and evidence/ (pictures with a README). No case ships in this repo yet; the first one is private.
expectations: Every stop puts what was asked beside what is there
No stop needs more than 100 words for what was asked and what is there
Visible text per stop: median at most 160 words, none above 220
Choices are bare: no colon, at most 12 words
No stop asks what should happen next
Every stop shows a figure in view
Every stop belongs to a part shown in the overview
Raw evidence is folded away in every stop
Other findings sit in a list that needs no answer (at least 3)
The overview shows every part: 3 to 7, each with an id
Every part in the overview shows a picture or a number
Plans are listed, not asked: a decisions list exists
The page can take answers, show their coverage and hand them back
No wireframe slot is left unfilled
Every picture the page points to is beside it
The run touched nothing it was told to leave alone
evals.graded_by: python3 evals/check_page.py {out}/index.html --json --transcript <the run's transcript> --forbid <each path the brief rules out>
evals.not_graded: Whether the stops are the right ones, whether each heading states its finding, and whether the parts are the ones a reviewer would name. A person reads one page per round for that.
